scope: Feeding records read from the full text of the original (not the title or abstract). Hand-extracted; every value carries a page or table locator. Fields the original does not state are null (not reported). Not a safety verdict.
identity_rule: A reported plant name is linked only through an unambiguous GBIF exact match (single usage, no homonym) or a GBIF synonym whose author is stated in the original. Genus-level names (sp., spp.) are never linked to a species.
